# Launch an online storefront

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When customers will select and purchase products through an online shop. An approved storefront with reconciled test orders, delivery and return paths, and a named operating owner.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Define the catalogue and selling territories

agent-runnable


List products, variants, stock sources, customer locations and fulfillment owners. Record restrictions and unresolved product information before preparing listings or committing to a selling channel.

- Sources: [Shopify store launch checklist](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/intro-to-shopify/initial-setup/new-to-shopify-checklists/general-checklist)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve commercial and customer obligations

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The responsible owner and advisers review selling permissions, pricing, tax treatment, delivery promises and returns. Resolve unsupported territories and products before approving checkout availability.

- Sources: [Shopify store launch checklist](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/intro-to-shopify/initial-setup/new-to-shopify-checklists/general-checklist)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare the storefront and order configuration

agent-runnable


Prepare product content, inventory rules, shipping options and support instructions in a draft environment. Keep actual customer information and payment credentials outside public source files.

- Sources: [Shopify store launch checklist](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/intro-to-shopify/initial-setup/new-to-shopify-checklists/general-checklist)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Configure the approved selling and payment accounts

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


An authorized operator applies the reviewed account settings and permissions. Record who controls payment access and keep the storefront unpublished while testing the order lifecycle.

- Sources: [Shopify store launch checklist](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/intro-to-shopify/initial-setup/new-to-shopify-checklists/general-checklist)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Verify the complete order journey

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The responsible operators check purchase, failed payment, cancellation, fulfillment, refund and stock reconciliation using safe test cases. Document failures and require fixes before exposing the affected journey.

- Sources: [Shopify store launch checklist](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/intro-to-shopify/initial-setup/new-to-shopify-checklists/general-checklist)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Authorize publication and operational handover

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


The owner approves the final store and public terms. An authorized operator publishes it, confirms production configuration and hands support, fulfillment and reconciliation duties to named owners.

- Verify: An approved storefront with reconciled test orders, delivery and return paths, and a named operating owner.
- Sources: [Shopify store launch checklist](https://help.shopify.com/en/manual/intro-to-shopify/initial-setup/new-to-shopify-checklists/general-checklist)
